summary: Iter-20 frontend verification of the two NEW Supermarket demo scenes (Scene 14 'Self-Funding Upgrade System' and Scene 15 'Warranty and Service Control'), the renumbered Scene 16 (Financial Impact) and Scene 17 (Closing), the homepage retail CTAs, and the rewritten retail industry tile. ALL pass. Start screen shows '17-scene', '17 cinematic scenes', 'Approximately 12 to 14 minutes', 'Auto-plays · ~14 min · Voice: Sage', and the 17-item story arc with 'Self-Funding Upgrade System' at #14 and 'Warranty Enforcement at Scale' at #15. Programmatic fast-advance (mute + dispatch 'ended' on audio elements) reached scenes 14, 15, 16, 17 with zero pageerrors and zero ErrorBoundary triggers. Scene 14 (data-testid='stage-self-funding'): all 4 inflow cards present (Energy waste / Repeat service avoided / Vendor overcharge reclaimed / Downtime sales preserved), 3-stat fund summary present ($4.62M annualized / $3.18M available pool / $2.33M deployed), all 4 upgrade-pipeline rows present (LED retrofit, Walk-in cooler, Refrigeration controller 72%, Loading dock motor), 'Estimated values' disclaimer present, and 'savings pay for the upgrade ... upgrade compounds the savings' tagline present. Scene 15 (data-testid='stage-warranty'): 3-tile portfolio numbers (2,184 / 184 / 47), all 4 enforcement case rows (WC-4012 ... WC-4144 with REPLACE/CLAIM/SCHEDULED/ESCALATION), 3-stat leakage block ($1.84M / $1.62M / 412 units), 'CreatorBoostAI does not perform installation' disclaimer, and the EXACT closing line 'This is not just warranty coverage. This is warranty enforcement at scale.' all confirmed. Scene 16 stage-financial-impact mounts. Scene 17 stage-closing mounts and contains both required lines plus all 6 capability tiles (See every store / Prioritize every issue / Execute every action / Save money / Recover revenue / Scale performance) plus the closer 'execution layer for modern retail operations'. Forbidden-vocab grep on /demo/supermarket: ZERO hits for BodyIQ, BodyIQ-AI, SRS, CPS, EOS, behavioral, nonverbal, 'human signal'. Homepage hero: data-testid='hero-cta-retail-demo' label = 'Watch Retail Demo' with 'Supermarket · C-Store' badge, href=/demo/supermarket; data-testid='hero-cta-supermarket-cstore' label = 'Supermarket & C-Store Demo', href=/demo/supermarket — both correct. Homepage retail industry tile (the Supermarket · C-Store · Retail one) contains '17-scene cinematic walkthrough', 'Cost recovery + asset intelligence · self-funding upgrade system · warranty enforcement at scale', and ZERO forbidden vocab. POST /api/tts/speak returns 200 audio/mpeg for both Scene-14 and Scene-15 narration text (153.6KB and 148.8KB respectively). Lint clean on SupermarketDemoPage.jsx, HomePage.jsx, images.js.

design_issues.screen: HomePage retail tile vs Supermarket demo start screen
issues: Runtime mismatch: retail industry tile copy says '~13 min' (HomePage.jsx line 109) but the demo start screen, narration, and spec for this iter say '~14 min' (Approximately 12 to 14 minutes). Minor inconsistency — not a blocker, but should be aligned to '~14 min' for a cohesive enterprise pitch.

Two entries share id='retail' (line 63 'Retail & Grocery' and line 102 'Supermarket · C-Store · Retail'). This causes duplicate React keys and duplicate data-testid='industry-tile-retail' on the page (confirmed in DOM — two elements returned). React will warn in dev console and automation/QA selectors targeting that testid will be ambiguous. Recommend renaming the new tile id to 'supermarket-cstore' or 'retail-supermarket'.

action_items: LOW: Align homepage retail tile runtime copy from '~13 min' to '~14 min' (HomePage.jsx line 109) so it matches the demo start screen and spec ('Approximately 12 to 14 minutes', 'Auto-plays · ~14 min · Voice: Sage').

LOW: Resolve duplicate INDUSTRIES id='retail' (HomePage.jsx lines 63 and 102) — duplicate data-testid='industry-tile-retail' on the homepage. Rename the Supermarket tile id to e.g. 'supermarket-cstore' to keep selectors unique and avoid React key warnings.

Carry-over from prev iters: SupermarketDemoPage.jsx is now ~1700+ lines after two new stages — strongly recommend extracting SCENES + each Stage component into /pages/supermarket/scenes/*.jsx and a /lib/supermarket-scenes.js barrel before adding more scenes.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate React key risk on HomePage.jsx: INDUSTRIES.map uses key={ind.id}, and two entries (Retail & Grocery, Supermarket · C-Store · Retail) both have id='retail'. Will trigger 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning and produce duplicate data-testid attributes.

SupermarketDemoPage.jsx file size growing rapidly (1500+ → 1700+ lines this iter). Each scene insertion is a global-touch change; extracting per-stage components reduces churn risk and merge conflicts on future scene work.

Runtime copy on the homepage retail tile (~13 min) drifted from the demo's own start screen (~14 min) when the two new scenes were added — this kind of cross-page string drift is exactly what a single shared constant (e.g. SUPERMARKET_DEMO_RUNTIME) in /lib would prevent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional spec; 2 minor copy/id design issues flagged

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-20 verified the two new Supermarket demo scenes (Self-Funding Upgrade #14, Warranty Enforcement #15), the renumbered Financial Impact #16 and Closing #17, the homepage retail CTAs, and the scrubbed retail industry tile. Functional spec passes 100%. Two minor copy/id design issues remain in HomePage.jsx: (1) retail tile says '~13 min' instead of '~14 min'; (2) duplicate id='retail' across two INDUSTRIES entries causes duplicate data-testid='industry-tile-retail'. The Crown/Workflow icon imports added in iter-19 are still in place and Scene 8 still mounts. To fast-advance through scenes for future iterations, mute all <audio> elements via setInterval and dispatch 'ended' Events on them — this approach keeps working.
rca of the issue: No P0/P1 bugs found this iteration. Minor RCA: the '~13 min' runtime on the homepage retail tile lagged because SupermarketDemoPage.jsx encodes its runtime locally ('~14 min') while HomePage.jsx hardcodes a separate runtime string in the INDUSTRIES array — when scenes 14 & 15 were added (extending the demo from ~13 → ~14 min) only the demo page was updated. Mitigation: hoist the runtime literal into a shared constant in /lib so both surfaces stay in sync.
